evals.prompt: Critique the homepage template and patterns of my block theme, I want a UX review
evals.expected_output: Read-only critique after the build: lenses from the rubric, findings only at confidence >= 80 with severity, lens, evidence and fix naming an owner skill, NEEDS MANUAL EVIDENCE or NOT RUN without rendered evidence, up to 3 Keep lines, one-line verdict. Never edits.

evals.prompt: Is the settings screen of my plugin consistent with wp-admin and accessible?
evals.expected_output: Admin and a11y lenses, core components check, cited evidence, one-line verdict, no numeric score.

evals.prompt: Fix the spacing in my theme so it looks better
evals.expected_output: Does not edit: the critic only judges; routes the fix to fswpdevops-design or fswpdevops-theme.

evals.prompt: Set up design tokens for my new block theme
evals.expected_output: theme.json palette by role, type scale, spacing, layout; presets not hard-coded values; contrast proven per variation; native-first; links theme and block skills instead of copying.

evals.prompt: Add a hero pattern to a client site that already has its own look
evals.expected_output: Reads the site's existing theme.json and patterns first, reuses its tokens, registers a reusable pattern, states covered.

evals.prompt: Design the screens of my Flutter app
evals.expected_output: Not WordPress: belongs to fsdevops, so this skill does not handle it.
